declarations.name: outputs.Proofs.FreyaTunedComplexity.literal_time_bound
declarations.type_text:
∀ (p : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Family),
  0 < p.m →
    0 < p.n →
      0 < p.S →
        p.S ≤ p.m →
          0 < p.ρ →
            p.ρ ≤ 1 →
              0 ≤ p.Lminus →
                0 ≤ p.Lpm →
                  0 ≤ p.Δ →
                    0 < p.ε →
                      outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.largeSample p.m p.n →
                        ∀ (f : Fin p.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space p.d → ℝ) (τ : Fin p.n → ENNReal),
                          Monotone τ →
                            ∀
                              (O :
                                OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request p.d p.m p.n))
                                  (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply p.d p.n)),
                              outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.PrimitiveService f τ O →
                                ∀ (N : ℕ),
                                  outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.eventLimit
                                        (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.familyRaw p false) ≤
                                      N →
                                    let q := outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.familyRaw p false;
                                    have P := ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.executionLaw q O);
                                    ∫⁻ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)),
                                        ↑(OracleTemplate.execute O (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.factory q) (fun x => N)
                                              z.1 z.2).2 ∂P ≤
                                      10 * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑p.m +
                                        ENNReal.ofReal
                                            (10 * p.Δ *
                                                outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.familyCoefficient p.toBase p.S p.ρ /
                                              p.ε) *
                                          (ENNReal.ofReal p.ρ * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑p.m +
                                            ENNReal.ofReal (1 - p.ρ) * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑p.S)

declarations.name: outputs.Proofs.FreyaTunedComplexity.normalized_optimality
declarations.type_text:
∀ (p : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Simple),
  0 < p.m →
    0 < p.n →
      0 ≤ p.Lminus →
        0 ≤ p.Lpm →
          0 < max p.Lminus p.Lpm →
            ↑p.n ≤ √↑p.m →
              ∀ (τ : Fin p.n → ENNReal),
                Monotone τ →
                  ∀ (S : ℕ),
                    0 < S →
                      ∀ (ρ : ℝ),
                        0 < ρ →
                          ρ ≤ 1 →
                            outputs.Proofs.FreyaParameterTuning.timeCoefficient
                                (outputs.Proofs.FreyaTunedComplexity.normalizedInput p τ)
                                (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.simpleBatch p)
                                (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.simpleProbability p) ≤
                              20 *
                                outputs.Proofs.FreyaParameterTuning.timeCoefficient
                                  (outputs.Proofs.FreyaTunedComplexity.normalizedInput p τ) S ρ

∀ (p : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.Params),
  outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.spec.valid p →
    ∀ (f : Fin p.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space p.d → ℝ)
      (O :
        OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request p.d p.m p.n))
          (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply p.d p.n)),
      outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.spec.admissible p f O →
        have A := outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimized (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.publicInput p);
        have P := (↑(A.law 1)).prod ↑(O.law 1);
        have out := fun z =>
          OracleTemplate.execute O A (fun x => p.n * p.m * (⌈2 * p.Δ * (p.Lminus + p.Lpm * √↑p.m) / p.ε⌉₊ + 2)) z.1 z.2;
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun z => ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) (out z).1‖ ^ 2) P ∧
          ∫ (z : A.Seed 1 × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)),
              ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) (out z).1‖ ^ 2 ∂P ≤
            p.ε

∀ (p : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.Params),
  outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.spec.valid p →
    ∀ (f : Fin p.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space p.d → ℝ)
      (O :
        OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request p.d p.m p.n))
          (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply p.d p.n)),
      outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.spec.admissible p f O →
        have A := outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimized (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.publicInput p);
        have P := (↑(A.law 1)).prod ↑(O.law 1);
        have out := fun z =>
          OracleTemplate.execute O A (fun x => p.n * p.m * (⌈2 * p.Δ * (p.Lminus + p.Lpm * √↑p.m) / p.ε⌉₊ + 2)) z.1 z.2;
        ∫⁻ (z : A.Seed 1 × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)), ↑(out z).2 ∂P ≤
          12 * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime p.τ ↑p.m +
            ENNReal.ofReal (96 * p.Δ / p.ε) *
              ⨅ S,
                min (ENNReal.ofReal p.Lminus * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime p.τ ↑p.m)
                  (ENNReal.ofReal p.Lminus * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime p.τ (↑↑S + 1) +
                    ENNReal.ofReal p.Lpm *
                      (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime p.τ ↑p.m *
                            outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime p.τ (↑↑S + 1) /
                          (↑↑S + 1)) ^
                        (1 / 2))

declarations.type_text:
∀ (p : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.Params),
  outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.spec.valid p →
    ∀ (f : Fin p.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space p.d → ℝ)
      (O :
        OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request p.d p.m p.n))
          (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply p.d p.n)),
      outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.spec.admissible p f O →
        have A := outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.simple (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.publicInput p);
        have P := (↑(A.law 1)).prod ↑(O.law 1);
        have out := fun z =>
          OracleTemplate.execute O A (fun x => p.n * p.m * (⌈4 * p.Δ * max p.Lminus p.Lpm / p.ε⌉₊ + 2)) z.1 z.2;
        ∫⁻ (z : A.Seed 1 × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)), ↑(out z).2 ∂P ≤
          12 * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime p.τ ↑p.m +
            ENNReal.ofReal (192 * p.Δ * max p.Lminus p.Lpm / p.ε) *
              outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime p.τ (ENNReal.ofReal √↑p.m)
